target: Smile Studio native iPhone 16 simulator, com.smilestudio.app
method: Actual mounted native app component handlers invoked through Hermes developer bridge; simulator framebuffer screenshots. Does not simulate touch.

button.reduceMotionMethod: Simulated native accessibility change event; restored to actual OS preference. No OS setting changed.

keyboard.note: Simulator hardware-keyboard mode hid software keyboard; geometry tested with simulated native events and then restored.

limitations: No physical touch or device haptic proof
Native export/build verification belongs to the coordinated feature task
